findings.description: scripts/build-mcp-command.mjs bundles @modelcontextprotocol/server 2.0.0 and Zod 4.2.0 into the 1.2 MB published MCP command while legalComments is set to none. Both dependencies declare MIT licensing, whose copyright and permission notice must accompany copies or substantial portions, but the packed Surface package exposes only the Surface Apache LICENSE and no third-party notice artifact. Preserve and publish the applicable dependency license texts through a packaged THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES file or equivalent generated notice, and add a package-content regression check before publication.

lanes.summary: Implementation, package architecture, build boundary, changed tests, and documentation were reviewed; the published bundle omits required third-party license notices.

evidence_refs.summary: The new esbuild configuration bundles dependencies and removes legal comments.

lanes.summary: Dual-era negotiation, request validation, read-only tool behavior, JSON-RPC stdout isolation, diagnostic sanitization, UI embedding, and modern/legacy protocol tests were reviewed with no additional open finding.
